description: Main implementation of a command-line utility 'curtail' that reads stdin and writes to a fixed-size output file, handling command-line arguments, signals, and file operations.

methods.name: crtl_cmdline_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and sets global configuration.

methods.name: crtl_parse_opt
methods.description: Handles individual command-line options during parsing.

methods.name: crtl_main_init
methods.description: Initializes the main process, opens output file, sets up environment.

methods.name: crtl_main_term
methods.description: Cleans up resources before program exit.

methods.name: crtl_main
methods.description: Main loop reading stdin and writing to output file.

methods.name: crtl_signals_register
methods.description: Registers signal handlers for SIGINT, SIGTERM, SIGQUIT.

methods.name: crtl_signal_handler
methods.description: Handles received signals, sets flags or logs.
